name: @w6w-apps/mural
description: Manage Mural workspaces, rooms, murals, sticky notes, text boxes, comments and tags.

w6w.longDescription:
Mural is a visual collaboration canvas. This app drives its public REST API from a workflow: list workspaces, rooms and murals, create, rename, archive, duplicate and delete them, search by text, and read who has access.

On a mural's canvas it can list and read widgets, add sticky notes, text boxes and comment pins, edit a sticky note, delete any widget, and manage the mural's tags - enough to turn a form submission, a ticket or an AI summary into notes on a board.

Mural only offers OAuth 2.0 (authorization code); there is no API key, so a Mural developer app must be registered and its client ID and secret entered when connecting. Voting sessions, timers, templates, exports, file/image/area/arrow/table widgets and membership management exist in the API and are not covered; the README lists them.
